parsed.rationale: Both `ProcessInfo.ThermalState.description` (in the sample-app `DebugHUD.swift` at line 237) and `PerformanceControls.thermalStateLabel` (in the production `PerformanceControls.swift` at line 152) are computed properties in the same `Wallpaper` package that independently convert a `ProcessInfo.ThermalState` value to a human-readable string, as evidenced by a Jaccard similarity of 0.75. The canonical fix is to add a single `extension ProcessInfo.ThermalState` with a `description: String` computed property in a shared file within `Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/Wallpaper/` (e.g., a new `ThermalStateExtensions.swift`), then delete the duplicate implementations in both files. Because one participant is `is_sample_app: true` and the other is production code, this is not purely coincidental duplication — the sample app is consuming the same domain concept and should reuse the shared extension rather than re-implement it.
